name: Crypto-vs-equity decoupling strength — crypto leads while SPX lags (long spot)
rationale: CROSS-MARKET RELATIVE-STRENGTH / statistical-arb flavor (spx_index x crypto momentum). A single-instrument approximation of a crypto-vs-equity relative-value trade with no pairs engine: when crypto is rallying (own momentum strongly positive) WHILE the broad equity benchmark (SPX) is NOT (flat or down — read via SPX cross_down through a level, the equity side failing to confirm), crypto is exhibiting genuine idiosyncratic strength / DECOUPLING rather than just riding equity beta. Decoupling-up has historically marked crypto-native demand (a self-sustaining leg) rather than a borrowed risk-on move that reverses when equities roll. Mechanism before data: long spot when crypto ret over a window is strongly positive AND spx_index crosses DOWN through a fitted level (equity NOT confirming — the divergence); exit when crypto momentum fades. Distinct from nasdaq-risk-appetite-leadlag (NDX UP CONFIRMING — the OPPOSITE, beta-on regime) and cross-market-dollar-weak-momentum (FX). The novelty is buying DIVERGENCE (crypto strong, equity weak), the inverse of the confirmation specs. Disconfirmer 1: drop the SPX arm — if bare crypto momentum matches the deflated Sharpe, the decoupling read adds nothing. Disconfirmer 2: decoupling can resolve DOWN (crypto catches down to equities); if requiring SPX-weak makes the edge WORSE than SPX-strong, crypto is beta-driven and the confirmation specs are right, not this one. Disconfirmer 3 (PIT/cost): SPX daily next-day-available; net of ~20bps the decoupling leg must clear. tier0 spx_index + tier0 ret_Nd, fresh prod data, unproven combination — low-confidence until OOS.
catalyst: strong crypto momentum WHILE SPX crosses down (equity not confirming) — idiosyncratic crypto decoupling strength, long spot
